name: What kind of paint is best for a basement?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for a basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: For basements, a high-quality acrylic latex paint is generally recommended. It offers good breathability and resistance to moisture, which is crucial in below-grade environments. Look for paints labeled as mildew-resistant or specifically designed for damp areas. Avoid oil-based paints as they can trap moisture and are prone to peeling in humid conditions. Priming with a waterproof or moisture-blocking primer is also highly recommended before painting to ensure better adhesion and protection against efflorescence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Acrylic latex paint is usually best for basements due to its moisture resistance and breathability. Use a moisture-blocking primer first.
